offer: One paragraph: what we sell and the outcome the buyer gets.
icp: Prose: who buys (industry, company size, geography, role, stage).

personas.economic_buyer: Who owns the budget, e.g. VP/Head of Sales.
personas.champion: Who pushes for it internally, e.g. Sales Ops / RevOps manager.
personas.user: Who uses it day to day, e.g. SDRs.

exclusions: Prose: who we never contact (agencies, students, <5 employees ...).
timing: Prose: when to reach out or not (holidays, mid-fundraise, just churned ...).
competitors: Prose: what a competitor looks like.
